name: Spacecraft Components Corp
old_description: Manufacturing and Distributing Connectors for 64 years and counting
about:
Spacecraft Components Corp. is based in North Las Vegas, Nevada, and has been manufacturing and distributing connectors since 1962. The company operates from a facility on Clayton Street and serves as a consultant for circular harsh-environment connector solutions.

The company engineers, manufactures, and distributes a range of circular connectors built for harsh environments. Its product lines include Reverse Bayonet, MIL-DTL-38999, 95234, 5015, 22992, 26482, and 85049 series, along with accessories such as dust caps, dummy receptacles, crimp contact wire adapters, termination bands, and flange gaskets. Spacecraft emphasizes consultative engineering support and technical sales to help customers specify the right connector.

Spacecraft serves the railway and transit, military, aerospace, and general industrial sectors, supplying connectors that meet stringent environmental and performance requirements. Its customer base includes prime contractors and maintenance organizations that need reliable circular interconnects for demanding applications.

Spacecraft differentiates itself through its AS9100-qualified quality system and a consultative approach that leverages in-house engineering and technical sales expertise to deliver tailored connector solutions for harsh environments.
